title: fix(console,app-shell,i18n): both login pages pass every LoginForm label, and the SSO four get auth.login keys in all ten bundles (objectui#12762)
body:
Fixes #12762
Clause-②: no

An SSO login now reads in the session's language on both login pages. The console's `LoginPage` and app-shell's `DefaultLoginPage` passed `LoginForm` none of its four SSO labels and no bundle had keys for them, so a zh-CN console showed `LoginForm`'s English defaults. Both pages now pass every `LoginFormLabels` member, and one pin holds them to that.

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/i18n`:** four keys under `auth.login` in all ten bundles: `ssoButton`, `ssoOnlyDescription`, `usePasswordText`, `backToSsoText`.
  - The English values are `LoginForm`'s own defaults, byte for byte, so an English session reads exactly as before.
  - The nine translations use each bundle's existing term for single sign-on, the one its `setPassword` / `recoveryReminder` / `oauthCallbackFailed` copy already uses: zh 单点登录, ja シングルサインオン, ko 싱글 사인온, de Single Sign-on, fr authentification unique, es inicio de sesión único, pt logon único, ru единый вход, ar الدخول الموحّد. Each also uses its bundle's sign-in verb and its `auth.login` register (es keeps the tú of the sign-in pages).
- **console `LoginPage`** passes the four, in the `t('auth.login.KEY', { defaultValue })` shape it already uses for the other members.
- **app-shell `DefaultLoginPage`** passes the four, plus the ten phone and verification-code members (`emailOrPhoneLabel` through `usePasswordSignInText`) from the keys the console page already reads. It keeps its own bare `t('auth.login.KEY')` shape.
- `packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx` does not change.

## The seat's hypotheses, measured

- **H0, reproduce first:** reproduced on unchanged `main` `020d178` (readings below). All four strings were English under zh-CN, not only the two the card measured.
- **H1, `LoginFormLabels` has 27 members:** 27, read with the TypeScript parser at `020d178` and unchanged on this branch. That count is a dated reading; the enumeration pin derives the list again on every run.
- **H2, same keys or separate ones:** the same `auth.login.*` keys, with the member name as the key name on both pages. The conventions differ only in spelling: the console passes a `defaultValue`, app-shell does not. Each page keeps its own spelling.

## Browser readings

Setup:
- Backend: objectstack `66d456d01`, `examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`. It was used as a backend only, with no edits.
- Console: this branch's `apps/console` on Vite, proxied to that backend.
- Browser: Playwright Chromium. `GET /api/v1/auth/config` was routed to the backend's own answer plus `features.ssoEnforced: true`, `features.sso: true` and one OIDC provider, "Acme IdP".
- Before = `020d178`; after = this branch's fix commit `b8be0b2`. Later commits add tests and the changeset only.

What each reading is:
- **SSO-only line:** the muted line above the federated button.
- **break-glass link:** read in the SSO-only view.
- **SSO button, back link:** read after clicking the break-glass link.

| reading | zh-CN before | zh-CN after | en-US before | en-US after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| SSO-only line (`ssoOnlyDescription`) | Sign in with your organization's single sign-on | 使用你所在组织的单点登录进行登录 | Sign in with your organization's single sign-on | same |
| break-glass link (`usePasswordText`) | Use a password instead | 改用密码登录 | Use a password instead | same |
| SSO button (`ssoButton`) | Sign in with SSO | 使用 SSO 登录 | Sign in with SSO | same |
| back link (`backToSsoText`) | Back to single sign-on | 返回单点登录 | Back to single sign-on | same |
| provider button, for reference | 使用 Acme IdP 继续 | 使用 Acme IdP 继续 | Continue with Acme IdP | same |

- The en-US before and after readings are identical as whole JSON documents: `diff` exit 0.
- `DefaultLoginPage` is not mounted by the console's routes, so its readings are the rendered-DOM pins below rather than a browser session.

## Pins

| file | what it holds |
|:--|:--|
| `apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.ssoLabels-12762.test.tsx` | Console page, real `LoginForm`. Under zh it draws the zh bundle's value of each SSO label and no English default. Under en the en bundle carries `LoginForm`'s defaults verbatim and the page draws them. |
| `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/defaultLoginSsoPhoneLabels-12762.test.tsx` | `DefaultLoginPage`, real `LoginForm`. SSO copy under zh and en. Under zh it also draws the phone and verification-code copy. |
| `apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/loginFormLabels-everyMember-12762.test.tsx` | **The enumeration pin.** It derives the member list from `interface LoginFormLabels`. Each page must hand `LoginForm` exactly those members, each as the zh value of `auth.login.MEMBER`, and every member must have a zh key. |

How the enumeration pin works:
- **The member list comes from the source, not the type.** The TypeScript parser walks `interface LoginFormLabels` in `packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx`.
  - A type-level list (`keyof LoginFormLabels`) is not reachable at test time: types are erased before vitest runs, and vitest does not type-check. So a type-level list could fail only in a type-check, never in the test run.
  - The walk fails loudly on an `extends` clause or on a member that is not a plain named property, rather than returning a short list.
- **What a page passes is captured, not inferred.** `LoginForm` is replaced by a stand-in that records `labels`; the rest of `@object-ui/auth` is the real module (`importOriginal` spread).
- **Where it lives:** in the console's test directory, because the console can import `DefaultLoginPage` from `@object-ui/app-shell` and app-shell cannot import the console page.

**Reverse verification.** The twelve source files were put back to `020d178` and the tests stayed at HEAD. Result: `Test Files 3 failed (3)`, `Tests 9 failed | 2 passed (11)`. The two that stay green are the walk's positive control, and `DefaultLoginPage` under en, which is a no-regression render that is English on `main` too. The restore was proven by `git diff HEAD` printing 0 bytes.
- The first reverse run read `8 failed | 3 passed`: the console leg of the value test was green on `main`. An unpassed member and a missing key are both `undefined`, so they compared equal. The leg now requires a string first (commit `fbff0f1`), and the second run is the one quoted above.

**Ablations**, one per behavioural pin. Each mutation went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit once, the blob changed, the restored blob equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` was empty after each one.

| mutation | red |
|:--|:--|
| console stops passing `ssoButton` | console zh SSO pin; enumeration, console: exact members and value legs (`3 failed / 5 passed`) |
| `DefaultLoginPage` stops passing `usePhoneOtpText` | app-shell phone pin; enumeration, app-shell: both legs (`3 failed / 6 passed`) |
| en `usePasswordText` drifts from `LoginForm`'s default | console en pin (`1 failed / 1 passed`) |
| zh bundle loses `backToSsoText` | console zh pin, app-shell zh pin, enumeration zh-key leg, both value legs (`5 failed / 6 passed`) |

The vitest aliases resolve `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` (with its `locales` subpath) to package `src/`, so no ablation leg needed a `dist/` rebuild.

## Local gates, at `95cf077`

- **Closure build:** `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console^... --concurrency=2`, `Tasks: 34 successful, 34 total`. App-shell, auth and i18n are inside that closure.
- **Type-checks:** `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` `type-check`, each exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` confirms all three new test files are in those programs.
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/auth/ apps/console/src/pages/auth/ packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/ packages/i18n/` gave `Test Files 143 passed (143)` and `Tests 1787 passed | 13 skipped (1800)`. `vitest list --filesOnly` over the same paths lists 143 files, the three new ones among them.
- **ESLint** on the 15 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: exit 0, 0 errors. The 3 warnings are on untouched lines of the console `LoginPage`.
- **Repo checks, each exit 0:**
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 15 source files of 3 released packages changed, 1 changeset declared.
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: every inline `defaultValue` matches the en pack.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-drift` and `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`: none of the four new keys flagged.
  - `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots` and `pnpm check:control-bytes`.
- **Governed surface:** `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 16 changed paths answers NOT GOVERNED.

The full farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- In zh, `usePasswordText` and `usePasswordSignInText` both read 改用密码登录. They never render together: the first is the break-glass link under SSO-only mode, the second is the way back from phone sign-in.
- `main` has moved since `020d178`, but no commit touches the bundles, either login page or `LoginForm`, so no merge was taken. objectui#12703 adds keys in another region of the same bundles; whichever of the two lands second merges `main`.
- `RegisterFormLabels`, read from source: both register pages pass all of its members. Nothing was found there and nothing is filed.
